interface.command: PS-loaded 128-bit command BRAM read port with two-cycle declared latency
interface.external_compute: seven common executor control channels; role-indexed 128-bit bank ports plus 256-bit paired read responses for GEMM roles 3 and 4
interface.dma: external 72-bit command, 64-bit data and 8-bit status AXI streams for each DataMover direction

control_rules.completion: Dispatcher releases a LOAD bank only after matching DataMover status and local adapter completion; the bridge delays adapter completion until its final registered 128-bit bank write has drained
control_rules.store_read: The bridge registers each STORE bank read request for one cycle; the adapter uses four cycles from issue to data return, including the bank's three-cycle read latency
control_rules.fence: FENCE waits for bank ownership and all prior DMA/compute completions, including S2MM DDR write status
control_rules.chunk: END/DONE permits PS to replace one command BRAM chunk; bank data and tensor validity survive until explicit reset
control_rules.source_validity: Bank tensor state tracker marks writes valid only after successful matching completion
control_rules.compute: No compute arithmetic is implemented in this module; external executors must obey command and role-bank contracts
control_rules.error: Transport, bank or dispatcher error-drain state asserts recovery indication. A mismatched compute completion retains ownership; control state and vendor DataMover IP must be reset coherently before restarting if no correct completion arrives

required_cases: two command chunks with retained bank data and tensor validity
DMA_LOAD FENCE waits for DDR status and final registered bank write
external compute stub reads two XPM banks and writes one
DMA_STORE FENCE waits for DDR status
bad DataMover status enters error state without DONE
mismatched executor bank ID retains ownership and raises recovery indication
reset clears control validity and ownership
legacy 128-bit DMA and compute-stub regression with striped bank subsystem
required_tools: self-checking XSIM with XPM and modeled DataMover streams
verification.proof_scope: integrated command/control/bank data flow with a testbench compute stub; no numerical executor, vendor AXI DataMover IP, DDR controller, placed/routed board or Vitis execution
